name: Perceived Performance Heuristics
axiom: Progress cues make the same wait feel shorter than a blank screen does.
trigger: An export runs for twelve seconds behind a blank screen, and people refresh because they think it froze.

checklist.text: Pair long operations with a determinate bar and motion that accelerates toward the end.
Replace a static spinner with skeleton screens or a pulsing placeholder.
Name the current stage in plain words: connecting, encrypting, finishing.

antiPattern.violation: A large export shows a blank page and a static cursor for twelve seconds.
antiPattern.remediation: A progress dialog shows a determinate bar, the current stage, and an estimated remainder.

academicOrigin.title: Designing and Engineering Time: The Psychology of Time Perception in Software
